problem: Warehouse staff create vendor returns by hand, and approvals are tracked in email.
solution: A return authorization form with automated approval routing and a nightly status sync.
impact: Fewer lost returns and faster vendor credits.
assumptions: Northwind will provide the approver list before development starts.
Existing vendor records contain a valid email address.
currentState: Warehouse staff email a spreadsheet to purchasing.
Purchasing keys the return into a vendor bill credit.
Approval status lives in email threads.
desiredState: Warehouse staff submit returns from a single form.
Approvers receive a task and respond in NetSuite.
Return status is visible on the vendor record.

openQuestions.question: Which return reasons require a second approver?
Should returns above a dollar threshold route to finance?

functionalRequirements.name: Return Intake
requirements: The form requires a vendor, an item, a quantity, and a return reason.
Quantity cannot exceed the quantity received on the original purchase order.
Submitting the form creates a return record in Pending Approval status.

functionalRequirements.name: Approval Routing
requirements: A task is created for each approver on the return record.
The return moves to Approved only when all approvers accept.
A rejection returns the record to the requester with the rejection comment.

functionalRequirements.name: Status Sync
requirements: A nightly job updates the vendor record with the count of open returns.
Closed returns are excluded from the open count.

technical.title: Return Authorization with Scripted Routing
technical.details: A custom record holds the return. A user event script validates quantity and creates approval tasks. A scheduled script syncs status nightly.

components.purpose: Holds the return header and lines.
Collects return details from the warehouse.

keyLogic: Quantity is compared with the purchase order received quantity at submit.
Approval tasks are created once per approver.

integrations.notes: Sent from the NetSuite email template.

outline.description: Validates the quantity on each line.
steps: Load the purchase order received quantity.
Reject the save when the quantity is higher.

outline.description: Counts open returns per vendor and writes the count.
steps: Search open returns grouped by vendor.
